data.name: Nadeer
data.gender_notes: Nadeer is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: one who guides, shows the way, a light in the darkness. The name Nadeer carries the meaning “guide, light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Nadeer usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: a name that symbolizes guidance and enlightenment from the divine
data.etymology: Nadeer belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “guide, light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nadeer total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: نadir
in_arabic.meaning: نادرة - الشخص الذي يملك صفات فريدة و نادرة الوجود
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم نادر مشتق من الجذر النادر، ويعني الشخص الذي يملك صفات فريدة و نادرة الوجود. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة الأنعام: 'وَمَا أَفْضَلُ مِنَ اللَّهِ حُكْمًا لِّقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ'. يرمز إلى التفرد و الندرة، و هو من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: نادیر
in_urdu.meaning: وہ شخص جس کی صفات منفرد اور نایاب ہیں
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام نادیر عربی زبان کے روٹ سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جس کی صفات منفرد اور نایاب ہیں۔ اسلامی تقویم میں اس کا ذکر اہم ہے، خاص طور پر سورہ انعام میں: 'وَمَا أَفْضَلُ مِنَ اللَّهِ حُكْمًا لِّقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ'. یہ نام تفرد اور ندرت کی علامت ہے، اور جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں اس کا خوب استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नादिर
in_hindi.meaning: जिसकी विशेषताएं अद्वितीय और दुर्लभ हैं
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम नादिर अरबी मूल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है जिसकी विशेषताएं अद्वितीय और दुर्लभ हैं। इस्लामी परंपरा में इसका महत्वपूर्ण स्थान है, खासकर कुरआन के सूरह अनाम में: 'وَمَا أَفْضَلُ مِنَ اللَّهِ حُكْمًا لِّقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ'. यह नाम विशिष्टता और दुर्लभता का प्रतीक है, और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका अच्छा उपयोग होता है।

in_pashto.name: نادر
in_pashto.meaning: هغه څوک چې ځانګړې او نادره ځانګړتیاوې لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: د نادر نوم د عربي ژبې له ريښې څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې هغه څوک چې ځانګړې او نادره ځانګړتیاوې لري. په اسلامي دود کې يې مهم ځای دی، په ځانګړي ډول د قرآن کريم په سورت انعام کې: 'وَمَا أَفْضَلُ مِنَ اللَّهِ حُكْمًا لِّقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ'. دا نوم د ځانګړتیا او ندرت نښه ده، او د افغان او پښتون دود کې يې کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Nadeer
in_english.meaning: Rare or unique individual with special characteristics
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nadeer originates from the Arabic root, meaning a person with rare or unique characteristics. It holds significance in Islamic tradition, mentioned in Surah An'am: 'وَمَا أَفْضَلُ مِنَ اللَّهِ حُكْمًا لِّقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ'. It symbolizes rarity and uniqueness, and is used across various Muslim cultures to signify someone with special qualities.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nadeer holds great cultural significance in Islamic tradition, as it is reminiscent of the fundamental concept of guidance in Islamic teachings. The Arabic root word "daar" (to guide or show the way) emphasizes the essential role of a leader or a teacher in guiding individuals towards the right path. Thus, the name Nadeer can be seen as a testament to the importance of leadership and guidance within the Islamic community. It also reflects the shared Islamic value of seeking and following the correct guidance in all aspects of life.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper, spiritual level, the name Nadeer holds immense significance as a reminder of the guiding role of God in everyone's lives. As mentioned in the Quran, "And We have sent you, [O Muhammad], with the truth as a bringer of good news and as a warner" (Quran 34:28). In essence, the name Nadeer signifies God as the ultimate guide and source of wisdom, strength, and hope, particularly during times of darkness and uncertainty. By embracing the name Nadeer, an individual acknowledges the significance of God as the guiding light throughout their spiritual journey. This recognition fosters a stronger connection with the divine, leading to increased reliance on God's guidance and support.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "guide, light" symbolizes one who guides, shows the way, a light in the darkness. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Nadeer serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of guide, light.
